Container.Name: AliExpressCoinCollector
Container.Overview: Collects the daily AliExpress coins on a schedule. It drives a headless mobile browser session to claim the check-in and the coin tasks, keeps the browser profile so the account is not treated as a new device, and offers a web dashboard for configuration plus a noVNC view for logins and captchas.
Container.Requires: The host port is 80, which assumes this container gets its own address from a custom network such as br0. On the default bridge network Unraid's own web interface holds port 80, so change the WebUI Port below before starting it there. Set a VNC password and a dashboard token before exposing this container. Without them both the noVNC view and the dashboard are open to everyone on the network, and the noVNC view is a live browser already signed in to the AliExpress account. Never forward either port to the internet; use a VPN or a reverse proxy. The container runs as UID and GID 1000 and does not honour PUID or PGID, so the appdata directory must be writable by 1000: run chown -R 1000:1000 on it once before the first start. Chromium needs the enlarged /dev/shm that --shm-size=1g provides; the Docker default of 64 MB crashes browser tabs. Do not delete the data volume: the browser profile in it is what keeps the account from looking like a new device.

Config.Name: Dashboard Port
Config.Description: Host port for the configuration dashboard.

Config.Name: noVNC Port
Config.Description: Host port for the noVNC browser view, used for logins and captchas.

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Browser profile, fingerprint cache, SQLite database, recon data and screenshots. Must be writable by UID 1000. Deleting it makes the account look like a new device.

Config.Name: VNC_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the noVNC view, 6 to 8 characters. Empty means anyone reaching the port controls a browser signed in to your AliExpress account.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_TOKEN
Config.Description: Access token for the dashboard. Empty means the dashboard, including the stored credentials, is open to everyone who can reach the port.

Config.Name: AE_EMAIL
Config.Description: AliExpress account e-mail. With e-mail and password set the bot signs in by itself; the e-mail code or a captcha is still handled through noVNC. Leave empty to sign in through noVNC only.

Config.Name: AE_PASSWORD
Config.Description: AliExpress account password, used only together with the e-mail above.

Config.Name: DRYRUN
Config.Description: true reads and reports without collecting anything. Useful for a first run.

Config.Name: BROWSER_LOCALE
Config.Description: Browser language of the emulated phone. Should match the account and its location.

Config.Name: DATA_DIR
Config.Description: Internal data directory; must stay in step with the data volume above.

Config.Name: DASHBOARD_PORT
Config.Description: Port the dashboard listens on inside the container; must match the dashboard port mapping.

Config.Name: NOVNC_PORT
Config.Description: Port noVNC listens on inside the container; must match the noVNC port mapping.

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Set to DEBUG while diagnosing a failing run.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone. The collection schedule follows local time.
